description: Use when an agent needs the paper behind a DOI. Returns title, year, authors, venue, citation count, open-access URL and the abstract where OpenAlex holds it (CC0 data). Send the slash of the DOI as %2F in the path. Costs 0.005 USDC per call (x402, USDC on Solana, Base, Polygon, Arbitrum or Arc).

doi.description: a DOI such as 10.1038/nature14539, its slash sent as %2F in the path

name: get_paper

data.description: the get_paper payload; a real captured example is free at https://x402.ochinimus.app/api/sample/get_paper

tool.description: the tool that produced this payload

title: Paper by DOI
